exams.title: Online Exams
exams.subtitle: Students answer on their own phones, over the school Wi-Fi. No internet needed.
exams.emptyBody: Create an exam, add the questions, then start it. The program marks it for you.
exams.shuffle: Mix up the question order for each student
exams.shuffleHelp: Makes copying from a neighbour much harder.
exams.noQuestionsBody: Add your first question to get started.
exams.acceptedHelp: Separate alternatives with | so spelling differences still count.
exams.stopConfirm: Stop the exam for everyone? Anyone still writing will be handed in as they are.
exams.joinCodeHelp: Write this on the board. Students type it on their phone.
exams.addressHelp: Students open this on their phone browser while on the school Wi-Fi.
exams.serverOff: The exam server is not running

exams.sendToReportCards: Put these marks on the report cards
exams.pushed: {{count}} marks added to the report cards
exams.pushNeedsSubject: Choose a subject and exam period on this exam first.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp to parents
whatsapp.sendAll: Send to everyone on this list
whatsapp.queueHelp: Press Send for each parent. WhatsApp opens with the message already written - you only press the send button there.
whatsapp.noPhoneBody: Add a phone number on the student's page first.
whatsapp.countryCodeHelp: Used when a parent's number is written the local way, like 091...
whatsapp.noHistory: No messages sent to this parent yet

library.author: Author
library.copiesHelp: Put 0 if this book only exists as a file.
library.digital: Can be read on a phone
library.attachHelp: A PDF students can open on their phone from the school Wi-Fi.
library.loanDays: How many days may a book be kept?
library.shareOn: Share the library on the school Wi-Fi
library.shareHelp: Students can then open the library on their phones and read the books you attached.
library.shareOff: The library is not being shared

transport.subtitle: School buses, drivers, who rides, and who has paid.

transport.feePerTerm: Cost per term for each student
transport.addRider: Put a student on this bus
transport.endRideConfirm: Take this student off the bus? Their payments are kept.
transport.onlyUnpaid: Show only those who have not paid
